description: PolyBench/GPU 2D convolution with the pinned signed 3x3 operator on an NxN matrix. One thread computes each interior output; setup leaves output borders zero. One kernel event time is emitted; source arithmetic is 9 multiplications plus 8 additions per interior output. Every measured output is verified by a full CPU reference after timing (fixed policy full_cpu_v1).

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
